# web-assets module root:
#   include/web_assets/ — the lookup and response policy
#   lib/                — its implementation
# The table itself is generated by the consumer (the application, or a test)
# with tools/web-assets/gen_web_assets.py and added to the consumer's sources.

zephyr_include_directories(include)

add_subdirectory_ifdef(CONFIG_WEB_ASSETS lib)
